title: Waste of money, unimaginative, total joke
text: I was so excited to get this..... Then I got it. Embroidery on a cheap fabric bag? Could you have been any less imaginative? The suggested design was for a child and not an adult and the value for the money is way off balance. The box is going back and the subscription cancelled. Wish I had read the reviews. This is hideous. To whomever designs these boxes.....  Stop it!
label: negative
